brief:
The Palestine Centre for Prisoner Studies announced that 91 detainees have been killed since the war on Gaza began, the Shehab Wire reported. Israeli authorities confirmed the death of prisoner Ihab Muhammad Diab, 36, from Gaza, bringing the total of confirmed fatalities among the detained population to that figure.

The centre's tally encompasses deaths within the prisoner movement during the ongoing conflict. Diab, identified as a resident of Gaza, became the latest detainee whose death Israeli authorities acknowledged. The rising count underscores the toll the war has exacted on Palestinians held in custody since hostilities began.
title: Prisoner deaths in Gaza war reach 91, Palestinian center reports
